title: Japan in Bloom | Group Tour Package
highlights: Experience Japan with a fully planned group tour that includes hotels, transfers, bullet trains, key sightseeing, and Indian meals, removing the stress of planning.
Cover Japan’s must-see experiences in one smooth itinerary designed for first-time travellers, balancing busy city days with relaxed sightseeing and travel time.
Enjoy handpicked experiences that define Japan like walking through Kyoto’s famous torii gates, visiting Hiroshima’s Peace Memorial, and cruising near Mt. Fuji.
Share the journey with a like-minded group making long travel days lighter, sightseeing more fun, and experiences more memorable.
Get flexibility with leisure time and optional experiences like Disneyland or free exploration, letting you shape the trip to your pace.
overview:
About the tour 
Embark on a captivating 9-day journey through Japan, exploring the beauty of Osaka, Kyoto, Nara, Nagoya, and Tokyo. Witness the enchanting charm of cherry blossoms in full bloom, immerse yourself in the ancient temples and shrines, and experience the legendary Shinkansen bullet train. Cruise across Lake Ashi, marvelling at the breathtaking views of Mount Fuji, stroll through the serene bamboo forests of Kyoto, and be captivated by Tokyo’s dazzling cityscape – a harmonious blend of tradition, culture, and modern innovation that truly embodies the essence of Japan.

exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Japan tourist visa assistance is included in the package; however, embassy fees, visa processing charges, travel insurance, and all applicable GST (5%) and TCS (5%) are not included and must be paid separately as per government regulations.

Group airport transfers are fixed with Osaka Kansai Airport (KIX) pick-ups at 3:00 PM and 7:00 PM on arrival day and Tokyo Haneda Airport drop at 7:00 AM on departure day; transfers outside these timings will be chargeable at INR 8,000 per vehicle (up to 4 guests).
Standard hotel check-in time across Japan is 15:00 and check-out is 10:00; early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed in advance.
Hotel rooms in Japan are compact by international standards, and triple occupancy (where applicable) may include a rollaway bed or sofa bed with limited luggage space.
All internal transfers, bullet train journeys, and sightseeing are conducted as part of a guided group tour, and guests must strictly adhere to meeting times to avoid missing scheduled services.
Bullet train tickets are booked in standard class with fixed seating, and any missed train due to late reporting will be treated as a no-show with additional costs borne by the guest.

Sightseeing at Mt. Fuji, Lake Ashi cruise, and Hakone Ropeway is weather dependent, and visibility of Mt. Fuji cannot be guaranteed; no refunds will be applicable in case of adverse weather conditions.
Cherry blossom blooming is a natural phenomenon and depends on weather conditions; while the tour is scheduled during the season, full bloom or specific flowering stages cannot be assured.
Meals are provided strictly as mentioned in the itinerary, meals are pre-set (no à la carte), and packed meals may be served on days with tight travel schedules.
Guests opting for Tokyo Disneyland or DisneySea will do so at an additional cost and minimum group size, while non-opting guests will have leisure time at their own expense.
Tipping is mandatory for this tour at 750 Yen / 5 USD per person per day, payable directly during the tour and not included in the package cost.
Japan follows strict public etiquette, including no loud talking on public transport, no littering, and adherence to local rules at temples, shrines, and memorial sites.

The tour operator reserves the right to modify the sightseeing order or make internal route adjustments due to weather, crowd control, or operational requirements without affecting overall inclusions.
Travel insurance is not included but is strongly recommended, as medical and emergency expenses in Japan can be significantly high.
Guests are responsible for safeguarding their passports, cash, and valuables at all times, and the company will not be liable for loss, theft, or personal negligence.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan, the Land of the Rising Sun! Upon arrival, at Osaka Airport get transferred to your hotel and complete the check-in process. The rest of the day is free for leisure, allowing you to explore the city at your own pace. You may choose to visit Universal Studios Japan for a fun-filled experience or head to Kuromon Ichiba Market to enjoy local street food and shop for regional specialties.

days.title: Trip to Hiroshima & Miyajima Island
days.desc: Today, embark on a Shinkansen ride to Hiroshima, Japan’s legendary bullet train. Experience the thrill of the journey and arrive in Hiroshima. Visit the Peace Memorial Park and Museum, reflecting on the city’s strength and resilience. Next, head to the Atomic Bomb Dome, a powerful symbol of peace. Then, take a ferry from Hiroshima port to Miyajima Island and admire the iconic Itsukushima Shrine with its floating torii gate. Return to Osaka by bullet train and then get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Osaka Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, embark on a city sightseeing tour of Osaka. Start with a photo stop at Osaka Castle, a renowned landmark that embodies the city’s rich samurai history. Next, head to the Umeda Sky Building to enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of Osaka’s modern skyline. Later, explore the lively streets of Dotonbori, where you can indulge in local street food and shop at popular stores. Then, get driven back to the hotel in Osaka.

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto & Arashiyama
days.desc: Today, set out on a day trip to Kyoto. Begin your day at the  Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, where you’ll walk through towering bamboo stalks that create a calm, otherworldly atmosphere. Continue to the stunning Kinkaku-ji Temple, the famed Golden Pavilion, shimmering beautifully against its pond and landscaped gardens. Later, visit the legendary Fushimi Inari Shrine, and stroll through thousands of red torii gates winding up the forested hillside. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour - Arashiyama Bamboo Grove + Kinkakuji Temple + Fushimi Inari Shrine

days.title: Transfer to Nagoya | En-Route Nara Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to Nara and visit the iconic Todai-ji Temple, home to the Great Buddha and one of the most important Buddhist temples. Continue to Nara Deer Park, celebrated for its free-roaming sika deer regarded as sacred messengers of the gods. Later, proceed towards Nagoya and visit Nabana no Sato, renowned for its beautifully curated floral landscapes and spectacular seasonal illuminations. After the tour, get transferred to your hotel in Nagoya for the overnight stay.

items.title: Trip to Todai-ji Temple & Nara Deer Park

days.title: Transfer to Tokyo | En Route Hakone Ropeway & Lake Ashi Cruise
days.desc: After check-out, get driven towards Tokyo. En route, stop at Sōunzan Station to board the Hakone ropeway and enjoy panoramic views of the Owakudani Valley, with its dramatic volcanic terrain and steaming vents, along with views of Lake Ashi and Mount Fuji. Next, enjoy a scenic cruise on Lake Ashi where you can also spot Mount Fuji from the lake, making it one of Hakone’s most popular experiences. After the tour, continue your journey towards Tokyo and upon arrival check in at the hotel.

items.title: Hakone Ropeway Cable Car Tickets, Japan

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, set out for sightseeing tour. Begin with Ueno Park, a popular green space known for its museums and historic shrines. Continue to Sensō-ji in Asakusa, Tokyo’s oldest temple, followed by a walk through Nakamise Street, lined with traditional shops. Stop for photos at the Tokyo Skytree, and later, visit Odaiba area to see the Statue of Liberty replica. Next, visit teamLab Planets, known for its immersive and interactive digital art exhibits. After sightseeing, get driven back to your hotel.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Tokyo Local Sightseeing Tour

days.title: Leisure Day
days.desc: Today, spend your day at leisure, where you can explore Tokyo on your own. You may choose to spend the day at the magical Tokyo Disneyland or DisneySea, where thrilling attractions and enchanting shows bring stories to life. Alternatively, explore the city independently, discover the upscale shopping avenues of Ginza, experience the energy of the famous Shibuya Crossing, or relax at a cosy café while soaking in the vibrant city vibe.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check out from your hotel in Tokyo. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your amazing Japan trip.
